scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n server,web "npm run dev -w @llm-compare/server" "npm run dev -w @llm-compare/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @llm-compare/contracts && npm run build -w @llm-compare/server && npm run build -w @llm-compare/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @llm-compare/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.lint: oxlint --max-warnings 0 --ignore-path .gitignore apps packages scripts tests playwright.config.ts vitest.config.ts
scripts.check:verbose: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run check:markdown-worker && npm run check:browser
